sentences.text:
Appellant :- Yaqoobi Bibi And Another
Respondent :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Appellant :- Dhirendra Babu Mishra
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saumitra Dayal Singh,J.
Order on Bail Application Heard learned counsel for the appellants, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

This appeal arises out of impugned judgement and order dated 19.12.2022, passed by Additional Sessions Judge/Fast Tract Court No. 1, Kaushambi, in Sessions Trial No. 36 of 2018 (State Vs.
Yaqoobi Bibi and another) arising out of Case Crime No. 299 of 2017, under Sections 304B, 498A IPC and Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Charwa, District Kaushambi, convicting the accused appellants and sentencing him under Section 304 B I.P.C to undergo rigorous imprisonment for seven years and the appellant further convicted under Section 498A IPC for 2-2 years imprisonment and fine of Rs. 20,000/- (each), in default payment of fine the appellant further undergo 6-6 months additional imprisonment, under Section 4 Dowry Prohibition Act I.P.C to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 1-1 years and fine of Rs. 10,000/- (each) in default thereof, to undergo 3-3 months additional rigorous imprisonment.

sentences.text: In this application, the appellants seek suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
Submission is, though the allegation of demand of dowry was made in the context of unnatural death.

At the same time, referring to the statements of PW1 and PW2 who happen to be parents of the deceased, it has been stated that the testimony is unreliable inasmuch as they have denied the allegations of demand of dowry at the time of marriage and have made statements indicating that the present appellants may have resided separately.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is seen that the appellants have remained confined since 16.12.2022 and there is no hope of early conclusion of appeal proceedings.

Considering the totality of the case, in light of the nature of evidence available on record, detention period of the appellants, the fact that the appeal may take some time for its final disposal, without further commenting on the merits of the case, I am inclined to release the appellants on bail.

Let appellants Yaqoobi Bibi and Kabir Ahmad convicted and sentenced in the above mentioned session trial be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Fifty Thousand)
and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned.
On acceptance of bail bond and personal bond, the lower court shall transmit photostat copies thereof to this Court for being kept on the record.
The realization of 50% of the fine shall remain stayed during the pendency of the appeal.
Lower court record has been received.
List the appeal for final hearing in due course.
